title: Verify: Zero-quota Send disabled and submit blocked unit tests
summary: Unit tests for disabled Send and no backend call at 0
description: Write tests with the backend mocked proving Send is disabled and submitContribution is never called at zero quota, and still called above 0.
acceptance_criteria: fireEvent.submit at 0 does not call submitContribution

in_scope: New test file for zero-quota gating

steps.action: Create the test file mocking ../src/api/client as in contributionMaxLength.test.tsx. Test 1: listMine resolves 5 items from contributionFixture (tests/fixtures/api, matching listMine's return type), await the message, assert getByRole('button',{name:'Send'}) is disabled. Test 2: same setup, type 'hello' in 'Your idea', fireEvent.submit on the form, assert submitContribution not called. Test 3: listMine resolves 1 item, type 'hello', click Send, assert submitContribution toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1) with 'hello'.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionQuotaGate.test.tsx
